A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same VASparse research and contain 21 readable pages, including supplementary Sections 7–12. Text, equations, tables, figures and appendices can be reliably matched despite title changes, citation renumbering and text reflow.

before.justification: v1 reports original hallucination-mitigation and decoding-speed experiments across three LVLM families, component ablations, attention analyses and qualitative case studies.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experimental results, including the main benchmark comparisons and supplementary quantitative and qualitative evaluations.

M1.justification: Sections 4.2–4.5 retain the same sparsification objective, visual-aware token selection and aggregation, sparse visual contrastive decoding, and attention-sink penalty. Their equations and procedures are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate CHAIR and offline POPE on MSCOCO, MME, and the GPT-4-assisted benchmark, with additional LLaVA-Bench qualitative cases. No evaluated dataset, task or scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged within corresponding tables and case studies, including the decoding, post-processing and token-sparsification methods. The newly cited Game on Tree work is not added as an experimental baseline.

E3.justification: Sections 5 and 7 retain the same metrics, prompts, backbone models, 64/512-token generation limits, corresponding beam sizes of 3/2, sparsification settings and 500-image empirical-study sample.

E4.justification: The component ablations in Table 4, decoder-depth analysis in Figure 5, supplementary attention visualizations in Figure 6, and qualitative cases in Figures 7–11 are unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions retain five-run averaging, the random-seed description in supplementary Section 10, and the same distribution plots in Figure 5. No repeated-run or uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: Tables 1–8 retain identical numerical entries, and the plotted and qualitative findings are unchanged. For example, Table 1 reports VASparse's LLaVA-1.5 CHAIR_i of 5.82, CHAIR_s of 18.51 and TPS of 27.73 in both versions.

T1.justification: Definition 1, the token-selection equations, Theorem 1 and its complete proof in supplementary Section 8 are unchanged. The same top-S selection optimality argument is retained.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about training-free hallucination mitigation, visual-aware sparsification and decoding efficiency. The shorter title does not change the research scope.

C2.justification: The explanations connecting hallucination to vision-agnostic pruning and attention sinking remain unchanged, as do interpretations of the ablations and short-output MME results. No substantive limitation or applicability qualification is added.

D1.justification: The implementation and reproducibility disclosures are retained, including hyperparameters, sparsification intervals, A100 hardware, GPT-4 evaluator version, baseline configurations and the code link.

R1.justification: Section 2 adds brief background on visual understanding and question answering, expands the NLP/LLM citations, and adds Game on Tree to the hallucination-mitigation discussion. Eleven references are added, but the central positioning and novelty argument remain unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 shortens the title, expands institutional affiliations, adds a funding acknowledgement and makes limited related-work wording edits. The main narrative and supplementary section structure remain intact.

P2.justification: The expanded affiliation block, acknowledgement and bibliography cause modest layout and text-flow changes. All eight tables and eleven figures retain their content and design; numerous supplementary pages render identically.

improvement.justification: v2 updates affiliations, funding disclosure and background citations, but leaves the method, experimental evidence, theoretical support and reproducibility information substantively unchanged, including the appendices. These limited editorial additions establish no meaningful overall quality gain or loss.
